subject.title: [Feature]: WhatsApp: add per-contact messaging policy for inbound, outbound, and autonomous replies

question: Should WhatsApp gain a first-class per-contact policy for inbound handling, explicit outbound sends, and autonomous replies, and what root/account override semantics should it use?
rationale: The code shape is clear, but this creates a new public config surface and a real contact-level authorization boundary; automation should not choose the security semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve unified contact policy
options.body: Add one WhatsApp-owned resolver with explicit root/account field-merge semantics and enforce it consistently in inbound, outbound, and autonomous reply paths.

options.title: Narrow to existing policies
options.body: Reject new contact config for now and document supported combinations of `allowFrom`, `sendPolicy`, `direct`, and plugin hooks as the intended workaround.

options.title: Defer for broader policy design
options.body: Keep this open but block implementation until WhatsApp contact policy is designed together with related outbound-only and service-scope admission issues.

recommendation.title: Approve unified contact policy
recommendation.body: Add one WhatsApp-owned resolver with explicit root/account field-merge semantics and enforce it consistently in inbound, outbound, and autonomous reply paths.
